title: Document T4 Relational Residual Freeze Boundary
objective: Create documentation explicitly recording the freeze boundary for T4 relational residual activation: that strict negative activation is structurally unreachable under the current deterministic backbone, that riskScore-only adversarial activation has been rejected, and that the same-target carry path exists structurally but remains behaviorally inactive.
exact_scope: IN: Create docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md documenting the three freeze boundary conditions; update current_phase.md and context/designer.md to reference this freeze boundary and prevent future patch attempts. OUT: No code changes to T4 builder, gate logic, or any runtime implementation; no calibration adjustments; no new activation logic.
constraints: Must not modify T4 builder or gate calibration
Must align with roadmap.md Phase 26B distinction (current freeze vs. future social-event reopening)
human review needed: confirm documentation file location and cross-reference format
acceptance_criteria: File docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md exists and is non-empty
docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md contains explicit statement that strict negative T4 residual activation is structurally unreachable under current deterministic backbone
docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md contains explicit statement that riskScore-only adversarial activation has been rejected
docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md contains explicit statement that T4 same-target carry path exists structurally but is behaviorally inactive
current_phase.md references the T4 freeze boundary documentation
context/designer.md references the T4 freeze boundary documentation
verification_steps: grep -qi 'same-target.*behaviorally inactive\|behaviorally inactive\|结构.*存在.*行为.*不活跃' docs/phase25_t4_freeze_boundary.md
non_goals: Do not modify T4 builder implementation or gate logic
Do not implement Phase 26B social-event activation
Do not expand bridge coverage to T3/T5/T6/T7/T8
Do not adjust residual creation thresholds or calibration
